name: THSV StreamBridge - Clip Courier
author: surakage
description: Creates Twitch clips from !clip and optionally publishes other clips made during the current stream to Discord.

actions.name: THSV Addon - Clip Courier - Create Clip

triggerSafety: Create Clip remains triggerless and requires one-use broker tokens. The existing Twitch intake owns !clip. Discord posts are sent by StreamBridge from the shared Discord webhook list.
verificationStatus: Source and automated contract verified; creator Twitch and Discord live acceptance remains required.
